description: One thing that happened to a member's interest: a contribution, a distribution, an admission, a withdrawal, a transfer or a reallocation. Every event carries a narrative, so a successor reading it in twenty years knows why it happened and not only that it did.

fields.label: Event Type
fields.options:
Contribution
Distribution
Admission
Withdrawal
Transfer
Reallocation

fields.description: The date the event took effect, which is not necessarily the date it was recorded.
fields.label: Effective Date

fields.description: Zero is legitimate: an admission or a reallocation may move no money at all.
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: The member this event is about. For a transfer, the member the interest moves FROM.
fields.label: Member

fields.description: For a transfer or a reallocation: the member the interest moves TO.
fields.label: Counterparty Member

fields.description: The Journal Entry that books this event, where there is one. Events that move no money — an admission, say — have none, and that is not a gap.
fields.label: Offset Journal Entry

fields.description: Set when a later event corrects this one. Nothing is ever deleted from this trail; a mistake is superseded, not erased.
fields.label: Superseded By

fields.description: Why this happened, in plain language, including which document authorises it. Mandatory: the numbers survive on their own, the reasons do not.
fields.label: Narrative

name: Member Event
